_comment: Frozen train/held-out split for the struggle-extractor quality eval. The hill-climber (P6) optimises ONLY on train; held-out drives final reporting and the overfitting gate, never keep/discard. Do not modify once the loop has run. 5 train + 3 held-out study sessions, with negatives split across both halves. Domains spread so neither half is dominated by one topic.
